verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is explicitly an API-first product (confirmed by community feedback) with full REST API for creating cards/cardholders, real-time webhook decisioning, and dedicated test-mode simulation of purchases—enabling scripted, non-interactive automation. Stripe also ships an official CLI for headless workflows and an MCP server for agent-driven interaction with the API. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or SDK-based automation tutorials specific to Issuing beyond general API/CLI docs.
